title: 5 Offbeat Hidden Gems in Delhi You Haven't Heard Of
summary: Ditch the crowds and explore these secret locations, pristine lakes, and untouched villages in Delhi.
content: While major sights draw crowds, the true magic of Delhi lies in its off-the-beaten-path locations. In this guide, we take you off the tourist grid to explore serene forests, secret waterfalls, and ancient local temples. We reveal spots like Hauz Khas Village and Safdarjung Tomb that have preserved their raw natural beauty and tribal culture, offering perfect retreats for solo backpackers and nature lovers.
